bio: A pleasant and well-run family-owned restaurant that has the perfect balance between passion and professionalism. It features three modern and functional dining rooms serving an updated take on regional cuisine that aims to bring personality to every dish, with a focus on locally sourced and, where possible, organic ingredients. Choose between several interesting menus, including a tasting option that requires pre-booking, which is complemented by a varied wine list. One speciality that you won’t want to miss is the rice casserole with butifarra confit and pork rib....
